_about: Values that may change without touching code. Amounts are in ether units of each chain's native coin (lREACT on Lasna, ETH on destinations). Starting values; they are tuned from measured fees and the change is recorded in docs/decisions/.

demo._fund_note: Demo contracts are funded once, at creation, and never topped up: they must go dark. Starting values; tuned from measured fees in P2b and recorded in docs/decisions/.

funds._note: deploy.sh tops the Keeper (lREACT) and Tank (ETH) up to these balances with a plain transfer (RT-5). funds.sh tukar refuses more than max_swap_eth in one faucet call.

text.tank_low: Pelita: tangki rendah ({detail}). Kenapa: Keeper tidak dapat menyalakan kontrak bila minyak habis. Buat: ulang langkah faucet (Baki KAU).
text.ward_dark: Pelita: kontrak dijaga {address} ({chain}) padam lebih {minutes} minit. Kenapa: Pelita gagal menyalakannya ({reason}). Buat: semak tangki dan had harian; tiada tindakan jika ini kontrak kawalan.
text.keeper_debt: Pelita: Keeper sendiri berhutang {debt} di Lasna. Kenapa: tanpa minyak Keeper berhenti menjaga semua kontrak. Buat: isi tangki Keeper sekarang (faucet, Baki KAU).
text.rpc_failures: Pelita: pengindeks gagal {count} kali berturut ({error}). Kenapa: RPC awam rantai itu (atau Blockscout) menolak atau tidak menjawab walaupun pengindeks sudah mencuba pelayan ganti; laman memapar data lama rantai itu. Buat: tiada jika ia pulih sendiri; jika berterusan sehari, semak state/larian.jsonl.
text.site_down: Pelita: laman {url} tidak menjawab {fails} kali berturut (kod terakhir {code}). Kenapa: kontena atau laluan proksi jatuh; juri melihat ralat. Buat: jalankan deploy/deploy.sh --status; jika kontena hilang, deploy/deploy.sh semula.
text.site_up: Pelita: laman {url} pulih (kod {code}). Tiada tindakan perlu.

census._since_note: One day before the event opened; matches the window measured before the build. Census and indexer start here unless --from-block is given.
